products.title: 10x10 Custom Printed Event Tent (Canopy)
products.body_html:
A 10x10 is the workhorse of the trade show floor — the entry-level footprint that still gives you a full 30 feet of branded canopy across the top. Ours is custom-printed end to end, built to order, and delivered in 5 business days. Not an estimate — a guarantee.

The canopy is dye-sublimated in full color on weatherproof tent fabric, so the print bonds into the material instead of sitting on top of it. It won't crack, peel, or wash out the way surface vinyl does. The frame is heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum — pop-up, no tools, and it packs into a wheeled bag you can roll through a hotel lobby.

What you can build

  • Tent Only — custom canopy + frame
  • Half Wall — canopy + one half back wall for sightline control
  • Full Wall — canopy + full back wall for a photo-ready backdrop
  • Complete Set — canopy, full wall, and side rails: the whole booth in one box

The details that matter

  • Full-color dye-sublimation print, edge to edge — no blank panels
  • Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum frame
  • Pop-up setup, no tools required
  • Wheeled carry bag included
  • Free digital proof before we print — nothing goes to production without your sign-off
  • Made to order in Los Angeles, backed by 20+ years of dye-sub production

Common questions

How fast can I get a custom 10x10 tent? Five business days from approved proof to shipped — guaranteed, nationwide.

Will the print fade outdoors? No. Dye-sublimation bonds the ink into the fabric, so it holds color through sun and weather far longer than a surface vinyl print.

Do I see it before it prints? Yes — we send a free digital proof and don't produce anything until you approve it.

Can you match my exact brand colors? Yes. Send your logo and color values; our production team matches them before anything goes to print.

Custom 10x10 event tents, printed and shipped from LA in 5 days. Questions on sizing or artwork? Call (844) 883-3308 or start your order above.
